title: airshow_3
author: Heigh-hoo
changes: A real single-engine propeller plane (an Extra 300 sport plane at an air show) buzzing past overhead, its engine note dropping as it flies away. Trimmed to 9.00–11.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.3 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (AT835ST microphone, Korg MR-1).
